title: Design: New Line keeps its header, other fields and buttons as drawn
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, that is not invoiced, so you can add a line to it.
  • Use a desktop browser window at full screen, at 100% zoom, so the window can be compared with the attached board picture.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1.
  • The header shows, from left to right: "New Line" in bold, a small purple "AI" tag with white letters, and "SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER" in blue capitals; a grey X sits at the far right.
  • Under the Description box: the word "Technicians", then a box reading "Add Technician" with a grey down-arrow at its right.
  • Next, one row of three boxes from left to right: "Labor Rate" (the widest, with a down-arrow), "Estimated Time" and "Tech Time", each with its small grey label at the top.
  • At the bottom right, in this order: "Save & Add Part" and "Save & Add Line" (white with a blue border and blue letters), then "Save & Close" (solid blue with white letters).
  • Side by side with the attached picture of board 1.2 at 100% zoom, the window shows these parts in the same order with nothing between them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R7: “Nothing else about the dialog changes, other than the label position in S1-R3: same fields in the same order, same validation, same values saved.”
  • S1-R5: “The canned-line picker at the top of the dialog is labeled "Title" and carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" in its typeahead box, the same as the free-text Title field. The dialog focuses this field on open, so the placeholder is visible the moment the dialog appears and clears as soon as the user types or picks a canned line. (Corrected 2026-09-10: the first build gave the picker no placeholder, so the prompt never appeared on a new line.)”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
